Notes: Merchant (AMME), Arrival hall (4604) at (192.5, 1.0, 224.3). Rebuilt from 2 QuestDialogCapture dumps (Merchant_AMME, 2026-10-20, character Soldaman, no quest state).

lost.Text: I was wondering where I should go. I'm a bit lost.

get_grid.Text: How can I get into the Grid?

got_it.Text: The fellow in the orange outfit, got it!

help.Text: Yeah, can I help you with anything?

business.Text: Yes, I am doing alright. I run a shuttle service and despite the Grid and all the teleporting technology business is good. There will always be real, old-style travellers around that prefer scenery while traveling between places.

grid.Text: The Grid is a computer network that people can enter into and travel between distant locations in digital form. It is an interesting little thing actually.

terminals.Text: There are Grid terminals over all on Rubi-Ka. Anyone can use them, but the more literate you are with computers, the more useful the Grid will be to you.

orange.Text: Have you tried talking to the colonist in the orange suit over by the entrance?

nice_lady.Text: Alright. Then you should talk to the nice lady over by the exit.
